attBesluta.text: I bought this for my new house that we are building. It functions as a replacement for my old hutch. It looks modern and beachy, which was the look I was going for in this spot. I put it together myself without difficulty.
Love it! Perfect for housing, larger kitchen appliances that I don’t want out on the counter
Broke while screwing. Had ti use wood glue. Otherwise strong. Would recommend for houses where no kids touching and running around. Can last longer in house without kids
Heavy duty material that I expect will last for a good while. Fits my Weber Genesis well. I’m very happy with it.
The pool cues I purchased are of good quality. They are perfect for first timers playing pool. I would buy more if needed. Shipping was fast and tracking was accurate.
De keu ligt lekker in de hand, ook goed te gebruiken bij libre. Enige klein minpuntje is de kartonnen koffer, maar gezien de uitstekende prijs wel te verwachten.
It’s good for the price, the plastic is thick enough and frame is sturdy; just have to have patients putting it together.
